section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1995
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1995 N.C.R.B.(M.H.A.) 1.2.7 Amongst the 23 cities(with population of over 10 lakh), Bombay city reported the maximum number of 'Accidental Deaths' (21.7%) followed by Delhi (15.8%). The rate of 'Accidental Deaths' was highest at Nagpur (135.57) followed by Varanasi (101.57) and Indore (71.27). It is heartening to note that Calcutta city which has second largest share in the population of cities after Bombay in India reported a very low accidental death rate of only 6.47 which was significantly smaller to those reported in other Metropolitan Cities.
